_about: Retrofit translation (skills/retrofit-project, 2026-10-15, framework tag v0.3.0) of this project's existing, never-tooled rules (AGENTS.md rules 1-8, CONTEXT-RULES.md) into the framework's generic gate schema (tools/gate/gate.schema.md). DOCUMENTATION ONLY -- there is no tools/gate/*.py or any other enforcing script in this repo, no CI, and no prior pull request (confirmed: `git log --all` and `git branch -a` show only direct commits to `master`; `gh pr list` and `gh issue list` on CarlitosRed/career-agent-hq both return empty). Unlike advance-po-reader's retrofit, this does not translate a real enforcing config into a parallel one -- it is the first time this project's informal rules have been written in gate-schema shape at all, and nothing here changes how this repo is actually written to today.
_fields_needing_a_decision_before_this_c: vendors.*.branch_prefixes are UNKNOWN as an established fact of this repo: it has never used branches before this retrofit's own PR. claude/ and codex/ below are carried over from advance-po-reader's and the framework's own convention for this first PR, not something Carlos has confirmed for career-agent-hq specifically.

The 2 tiers below restate AGENTS.md rule 4 (one writer per file) and rule 5 (author never reviews own work) as approval counts, which is the most literal mapping available -- but no PR has ever existed here to calibrate against, so treat this as a first draft pending Carlos's confirmation, not settled policy.
plan_go is false on every tier: no 'go' signal convention has ever existed in this project (AGENTS.md has no equivalent of a plan-lock step).
body_headings is empty: no PR body convention exists yet -- this retrofit's own PR is the first PR this repo has ever had.
required_checks is empty: there is no CI in this repo (no .github/workflows, no test suite). This project produces documents, not code.
